items.title: Budget 2027: Childcare costs slashed by 1000 euros for working families

items.title: Alcaraz reaches Japan Open final as Shapovalov retires with injury

items.title: Baartman forced off with injury in South Africa U23's 1-1 draw with Algeria

items.title: Strathbogie Shire man claims $1.2 million TattsLotto jackpot after dentist appointment
items.detail: A Victorian man discovered he won $1,247,390.16 in TattsLotto draw 4715 while driving home from the dentist on Saturday, September 26.
